current_state_summary.7B_int8: near-native repeatability (0.977x avg, 0.990x median), checkpoint tagged PRT_PHASE14N_7B_INT8_CHECKPOINT
current_state_summary.claims_scope: measured CPU setup only, no universal/production/GPU/larger-than-7B claims permitted

validated_claims: Qwen2.5-3B INT8 PRT reached repeatable native-parity throughput on the measured CPU setup (21.0 t/s both modes, 10/10 runs)
Qwen2.5-7B INT8 PRT retained ~97.7% average and ~99.0% median native generation throughput on the measured CPU setup
INT8 sidecars preserved tested output quality across all measured prompts and model sizes (0 quality degradations)
INT8 sidecars were much faster than float32 PRT sidecars (e.g., 0.5B: 94.3 t/s INT8 vs 50.1 t/s float32)
Sidecar loading succeeded 28/28 on 7B and 36/36 on 3B; fallback limited to force-native layers 11 and 15
Packed sidecar format (combined int8 weights + per-row scales in one file) scales across model sizes
forbidden_claims: no exact equivalence across all prompts/tasks
no claim outside measured CPU setup

recommendation.name: Full 8-Prompt 7B INT8 Validation
recommendation.goal: Run same 8-prompt suite used for 3B against Qwen2.5-7B native and INT8 PRT; confirm quality, timing, shape evidence, fallback behavior, memory stability
recommendation.reason: Completes 7B story symmetrically with 3B before attempting optimization or publication. Low risk given Phase 14M repeatability result. Low time cost. Highest credibility value per time invested.
after_14p_branches: Path A: Phase 14Q lab writeup -> then INT4 prototype or optimization
Path B: Phase 14Q INT4 prototype -> then writeup
